question: Does bounded contradiction-triggered local directed-edge repair improve held predictions after an unfamiliar causal mechanism shift, while retaining preshift relationships, versus fully fitted conventional online-change controls?
hypothesis: A local edge-memory repair gate will exploit sparse causal rewiring while preserving unaffected action/state relationships. The model may be inferior to fully fitted Bayesian change point and correctly specified exact structured Bayes, which is a scientifically valid NO-GO.

inputs.name: source-free five-state directed transition dynamics
inputs.source: the exact data_spec string, deterministic SHA256-derived streams per seed/phase/state/action; no reused ENERGY-FLUX-01 or ENERGY-TOPO-02 seeds
inputs.sha256: computed in source from exact data_spec on readback; prereg string itself is frozen

frozen_design.mechanism: N=5 observable labels. Hidden random directed Hamiltonian cycle C of 5 states per world. Action0 always follows C; action1 preshift follows inverse(C). At adaptation boundary, action1 becomes target-swap of TWO distinct randomly chosen action1 source rows (uniform over ten unordered row pairs) under LOCAL_SWAP (non-cycle permutation allowed); action1 follows C under GLOBAL_REVERSE; action1 stays inverse(C) under NULL. Each outcome has P=0.85 at target, P=0.0375 for each other state. Learners see only (state,action,next_state) observations, public epoch boundary and ordering, never hidden C, shifted-row indices, scenario, or outcome target.
frozen_design.split: Per world: fit epoch has exactly 4 independent (s,a,next_s) samples for each of 5 states x2 actions (40); adaptation epoch has exactly 3 further independent samples per (s,a) (30); held post epoch has 128 independent outcomes per row (1280). 12 seeds x3 scenarios =36 worlds, 2520 fit+adapt samples, 46080 held events. Pre/post hold are generated by independent SHA256-keyed streams; no held labels at fit.
frozen_design.ordering: Read all action0/action1 fit observations, save exact preshift prediction snapshot, ingest adaptation observations sequentially in fixed state/action/sample order; cold JSON restore, then evaluate. All arms receive same public ordered observations and epoch boundary. Candidate retains old historical predictions under separate readout; scoring does not train.
frozen_design.capacity: Fixed 5x2x5 categorical counts or state rows, no learned model expansion. Candidate: pre Dirichlet(0.5) and post Dirichlet(0.5); per action/state compute integrated Bayesian change-vs-stay log evidence with equal parameter priors, but use fixed hard contradiction threshold posterior_change>=0.75, then reset from post counts; otherwise pool pre+post counts. Action0 protected by pooled update; action1 local rows gated independently. Historical readout snapshot retained. Maximum 2 snapshots + 10x5 counts, JSON-serializable. No source law or hidden shift given.
comparators: fully fitted static pooled Dirichlet(0.5) per state/action
fully fitted recency-weighted Dirichlet(0.5) pre-count weight 0.25 and post weight 1
fully fitted row-independent Bayesian change-point mixture (prior change 0.25) with exact Dirichlet-multinomial integrated post likelihood
fully fitted global action1 change-point Bayesian mixture with integrated evidence

correctly specified exact structural Bayesian oracle: 24 hidden cycles x 12 source-law shift hypotheses, equal 1/3 prior per mode, uniform 1/10 pair prior conditional on LOCAL_SWAP, fully posterior marginal; oracle lower expected Brier is NOT a competition target
frozen_design.equality: All arms see 70 public transitions per world, same known N and order; only exact oracle knows full true source family and receives NO hidden label. Include oracle as context, not candidate-superiority target. No test-time adaptive action advantage; fixed observation schedule.
metrics: post action1 Brier and row-level changes
NULL false action1-change detections from candidate's fixed change posterior >=0.75
preshift action1 historical functional readout retained across cold restart
action0 Brier against original frozen readout and post readout
per-arm full CPU and wall cost including fit+serialize+restore+held predictions with common data-generation cost allocated equally
serialized predictor bytes and process total runtime
frozen_design.compute_budget: stdlib-only Python, one primary pass 36 worlds x 1280 held x7 predictor arms; no post-primary threshold selection; maximum 1 million simulator transitions; record per-arm fit/serialize/restore/scoring cost in common process on same host
frozen_design.seeds_and_draws: stream keyed by sha256(experiment_id, seed, scenario, phase, action, state, optional hidden). Stable hidden order; outcome noise independently sampled in each stream. No training or evaluation on original Yggdrasil sources.

controls: NULL no-change negative 12 worlds; cannot declare change
exact oracle as theoretical scoring floor
source-free deterministic smoke seed distinct from all 12 primary seeds
preswitch action0 and action1 memory readout after JSON cold restoration

classification_rules.supported: Compared with best of the five fully fitted conventional adaptive controls, candidate must improve aggregate held post action1 multiclass Brier >=0.01 AND achieve 0/12 false change declarations under NULL, preserve exact 36/36 prior readouts after cold restore, and post action0 Brier no more than +0.01 from best conventional protected action0. Independent scientific first use and dual-platform qualification still necessary.
classification_rules.efficiency_alternative: Measured candidate full CPU+common generation <=0.5x best conventional change-Bayes comparator, with held post action1 Brier <= comparator+0.005 and all negative controls/retention passing. Do not use partial fit-only speed as substitution.
classification_rules.mixed: Candidate improves >=0.01 over static pooled Dirichlet on LOCAL_SWAP post action1 Brier but fails fitted dynamic control superiority or a negative/retention/efficiency requirement. MIXED never implies native gain.
classification_rules.negative: Valid frozen evaluation with no qualifying supported/mixed result, especially if fully fitted change-point control dominates.
classification_rules.invalid: Generator/data overlap, source not committed before scoring, missing matched strongest controls, post-score threshold tuning, hidden topology/scenario leakage, scenario-dependent learner parameter selection, incompatible data/action count, source digest or custody failures, or executed source not matching repository-frozen Git blob. Infrastructure failures must be separate.

prohibited_after_primary_run: any replay of 12 consumed primary seeds
test hidden held states during fit
preregistration_note: Commit/read back this prereg BEFORE experiment source, before smoke/primary. Commit/read back executable code BEFORE primary scoring. Exact-source semantic tests with separate smoke seed first. Preserve all negatives and report source-custody limits. Add to existing draft PR #1346 only; no new PR.
